SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.user_id AS userId, la.login_id AS loginId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '') AS departmentNm, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT r.role_code, ',' ORDER BY r.role_code), '') AS roleCodesText, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, la.login_code AS loginCode, COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') AS useAt, COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') AS loginUseAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.user_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account_role lar ON lar.login_id = la.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
AND ( LOWER(u.user_nm) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(u.email_addr) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.department_nm, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NOT (COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y')
GROUP BY u.user_id, la.login_id, t.tenant_code, u.user_nm, u.email_addr, d.department_nm, u.use_at, la.use_at, la.login_code, u.created_at ) user_query WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex} AND #{lastIndex} ORDER BY rn

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
AND ( LOWER(u.user_nm) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(u.email_addr) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.department_nm, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NOT (COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y')
GROUP BY u.user_id, la.login_id, t.tenant_code, u.user_nm, u.email_addr, d.department_nm, u.use_at, la.use_at, la.login_code, u.created_at ) counted

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, la.login_id AS loginId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, u.user_nm AS userNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '') AS departmentNm, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT r.role_code, ',' ORDER BY r.role_code), '') AS roleCodesText, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, la.login_code AS loginCode, COALESCE(u.use_at, 'N') AS useAt, COALESCE(la.use_at, 'N') AS loginUseAt FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account_role lar ON lar.login_id = la.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, la.login_id, t.tenant_code, u.user_nm, u.email_addr, d.department_nm, u.use_at, la.use_at, la.login_code
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_department (tenant_id, department_nm, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{departmentNm}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO tb_login_account_role (login_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (login_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO tb_login_account (tenant_id, login_code, password_hash, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{loginCode}, #{passwordHash}, #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO tb_user (tenant_id, login_id, user_nm, email_addr, department_id, use_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{loginId}, #{userNm}, #{emailAddr}, #{departmentId}, #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET user_nm = #{userNm}, email_addr = #{emailAddr}, department_id = #{departmentId}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}

choose.when: UPDATE tb_login_account SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
